Investigate origins and etymology of the.title: What Is Misogynoir?
Investigate origins and etymology of the.summary: Misogynoir is the anti-Black racist misogyny that Black women experience. It combines the terms "misogyny," the hatred of women, and "noir," the French word for "black," to denote what Bailey describes as the unique form of anti-black misogyny faced by black women.
key_points: Specifically targets Black women and girls

Investigate origins and etymology of the.title: Misogynoir
Investigate origins and etymology of the.summary: Misogynoir is a term referring to the combined force of anti-black racism and misogyny directed towards black women. The term was coined by black feminist writer Moya Bailey in 2008.

Investigate origins and etymology of the.title: We started the movement: Misogynoir
Investigate origins and etymology of the.summary: Moya Bailey coined the term misogynoir in 2008 to address the specific anti-Black racist misogyny that Black women experience.
key_points: First spoken about by Sojourner Truth in 1851, using a different term
